name: Do I need a permit for an accessible bathroom renovation in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for an accessible bathroom renovation in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for an accessible bathroom renovation in Daly City depend on the scope of the project. Minor cosmetic updates or simple fixture replacements generally do not require a permit. However, any work involving structural changes, alterations to plumbing or electrical systems, or changes to the footprint of the bathroom will typically necessitate a permit from the City of Daly City planning and building department. We assist with navigating these requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits in Daly City are needed for structural, plumbing, or electrical changes, but not for minor cosmetic updates. We can help clarify specific project requirements.
